title: Raccoon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='62' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#c3cae6'/>
  <!-- mask -->
  <path d='M33 46 Q48 40 63 46 Q60 54 48 54 Q36 54 33 46 Z' fill='#3f4670'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='3' fill='#f5f7ff'/>

  <path d='M48 55 Q45 59 42 56' stroke='#3f4670' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
